name: A novel with annotations
vera_note: Paperback. The cover is a woman standing in a field, which tells you nothing. Pencil annotations throughout, two different hands — the first careful and academic, underlining phrases about memory and continuity. The second responding directly to the first, in the margins of the margins. 'You're missing the point,' written sideways next to someone else's underlined sentence. They never finished the argument. The book ends mid-annotation.
